dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I have nothing to say about that. I'd rather keep my memories about that place and its people to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I do run into my former colleagues here sometimes. But I was never very well-known.

dialogues.speaker: Clynes
dialogues.text: I don't think they recognize me as a former employee of the Fontaine Research Institute. Which makes life easier for me...
